"Photograph" by Ringo Starr was co-written by Ringo Starr and George Harrison, his former bandmate from the Beatles [d1][d3]. According to Wikipedia, it is the only song officially credited to the pair, even though they collaborated on other songs [d1]. Ringo Starr himself confirmed the co-authorship, stating in a 2007 interview: "I was writing it with George Harrison, so that also helped" [d7]. The song was begun in the South of France in 1971 and was first recorded in late 1972 during sessions for Harrison's Living in the Material World album, with the officially released version recorded in Los Angeles with producer Richard Perry [d1][d6]. On the recording, Harrison sang harmony vocals and played 12-string guitar [d4][d6], and the song is also credited to Richard Starkey (Ringo Starr's birth name) and George Harrison [d10].
